scenes.summary: While entering the Xiranite Central Laboratory, Chen fumbles around and accidentally records her silly face in the system.

lines.text: Personal information updates recorded for Chen Qianyu. Identity verified. Access granted.
Wha...?! No-no-no, that's not what I meant! Hey redo that!
Why...!
Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.
You passed the check? This thing's definitely not scanning faces!
Then if I do this...
Biometric verification failed. Bio-biometric veri-verification ... failed!
Identity verified. Highest authority level confirmed. Access granted.
Chen, Tianshi Zhuang is still waiting for us.

scenes.summary: Zhuang Fangyi and the Tianshi of the Xiranite Central Laboratory are calibrating the data. The test has repeatedly failed due to the accident. You decide to help Zhuang complete the testing before new issues start to appear.

lines.text: T-15 minutes to threshold. Class one cooling system reports normal pressure.
Initiate third Xiranite energy injection. Monitoring instruments, prepare for datalogging.
Readings from channel B-34 are exceeding the expected range from the pre-test simulations.
Attempt recalibration. Try to minimize the interference.
...It's not working. I'm getting the same thing. None of my numbers match those from Yinglung.
Interference eliminated. Let's go for another run.
We continue. Initiate fourth Xiranite energy injection.
Tianshi Zhuang, data adjustments for this run look pretty big. We might...
...Ah! STOP THE RUN! STOP IT!
*Sigh*... Chang Yun, how many runs have we had at this?
Let me do it. But I need you to sort out the readings from the runs. Take a short break, and we'll continue after that...
Endmin?
Okay then... Since the Endmin volunteered, I'll let you handle this little task.
Stop whining. Get some water and cool off the stabilizing rod. The cooling system's down again.
Water? That's like baseline cooling efficiency. Your senior knows ice-making Originium Arts, right? Maybe we should get him instead.

options: Let's not have Tianshi Zhuang run the errands.
Wanna try my jet drone? It's super effective.

lines.text: The area upstairs is the administrative office and labs for various fields of science.
However, I believe you'll be more interested in the data room.
Some of your old files and documents are stored there. Would you like to have a look?
This way, please.

scenes.summary: You and Zhuang Fangyi pass by a blooming pear tree in the city. She suddenly mentions that the very first pear tree of the city was your gift for the city. A young Tianshi suddenly runs in and informs you that a sky pole for a performance was lost at Fangxing Avenue. Zhuang decides to drag you along and retrieve the device.

lines.text: Ma ... ma'am ... we've got ... bad news! I ... I...
Take a breath. And then go on.
One of the sky poles we're using for the performance ... we're just test flying the unit...
...but the signal went out above ... Fangxing Avenue... We lost it...
Fangxing Avenue...
Oh. The pear blossoms are blooming already...
Mi Fu's got a point. This lab's swallowing whole seasons. There goes spring again.
You like it?
Hmm. This pear blossom aroma... I know it from somewhere.
Did you just remember something?
You actually brought a pear blossom sapling during your last visit to the Science Station. You even said a day will come when you'll raise a blooming orchard in Wuling.
A blooming orchard...
That must have been rather difficult in a place overrun by the Blight.
Indeed. Preserving beautiful flowers like these is never easy, especially in those difficult times.
But look, I have succeeded.
Come with me, Endmin!

scenes.summary: Zhuang Fangyi drags you along to find the disconnected sky pole. However, the drone suddenly starts flying towards Fangxing Avenue.

lines.text: Sorry ... for dragging you all along. I got a little carried away. Hope you don't mind...
Yes. It matters a lot, actually. I don't want this to spoil the event later on.
I'm glad to hear that.
So, in order to live up to your expectations, we should address this issue quickly.
This sky pole seems to be flying normally... Maybe there's something wrong with its sensors.
Odd...
Mm!

options: Is this sky pole really that important?
This event is making you nervous. I'm curious.

scenes.summary: Zhuang Fangyi and you run into a weeping child named Xiao Xiang. The boy tells you where the sky pole flew, and Zhuang Fangyi promises to give him an exclusive Chubby Lung from the TGCC crossover event.

lines.text: Waaa —! My chubby lung...! *Sniff*...
Xiao Xiang? It's alright. Tell me what's wrong.
...It's the bad machine... WAAA —! A bad machine took my chubby lung!
There, there. Now where did this machine go?
Over there... *Sniff* It flew over there...
Thank you for telling me that. Let's buy you another chubby lung, okay?
Really...?
Then ... then I want the special TGCC crossover exclusive!
Okay. The special crossover exclusive it shall be.

scenes.summary: Eager passersby of Fangxing Avenue try their best to intercept the sky pole, but the drone still manages to escape and make its way towards a hot pot eatery.

lines.text: No worries. Just let us handle this.
The truck looks alright. We'll move it out of the way. Can't afford to let it affect the performance event.
Got anything else I can help you with?
Shen! Tianshi Zhuang! Let's surround this thing! Block that path! I'll cover here!
Thank you, everyone.
Endmin!
Hah. This one's slippery. I'll block that side.
Oh... OI! QUIT MOVING! Bloody machine!
Shall we continue the chase?
We've got to stop that sky pole.

options: Where are you going, little pole?

scenes.summary: The out-of-control sky pole flies into a hot pot. It then reboots itself and flies around some more. The sky pole then rams itself into a lamp post, finally ending the debacle.

lines.text: The performance's about to start. How am I supposed to serve anyone with this mess...
My deepest apologies, Engineer Pan. I should have retrieved it sooner.
Oh ho-ho, Tianshi Zhuang... Can't believe you're personally running this errand.
Worry not. It's just cheap soup base. How about grabbing a meal? The performance is about to start!
WHA?! Geez!
ARRRGH — My shirt!
IT'S ALL OVER MY HAIR!
HAHAHA! So cool!
AAARGGHGH! CHILI OIL! MY EYES BURNING!
Terribly sorry, people!
Oh dear...
Ah, Endmin! You're here as well.
As for this sky pole... Its frequency readings have Fu Bo's —

options: Put this unfortunate diner's tab on Endfield...

scenes.summary: In a rare moment, Zhuang Fangyi shows you her relaxed expression. She hopes the experience has somewhat changed your views about Wuling. The city streets become increasingly boisterous and lively. The carefully rehearsed sky pole performance is about to begin.

lines.text: I'll try.
Really? That's good.
The drone caused a serious mess. Fu Bo needs to review this properly...
Sorry for suddenly involving you in this.
Fangxing Avenue often hosts events for Wuling's residents. In a city encircled by threats, these gatherings do wonders for morale.
And this little thing ... is one of the most important performers we have for today.
The world-changing missions of Endfield may call. But if you become blind to those who support you, that would be a shame...
But ... when I saw that malfunctioning sky pole ... darting about without a goal in mind...
Ah, Tianshi Zhuang? Here to watch the performance?
New Bamboo Dew Milk Tea! Second cup half price!... Here! Just take the last two! On the house!
One for solitary joy, two to unlock happiness!
Finally sold them all! Time to call this shift! BYE!
Tell me, what is the Wuling you see?
Oh, it's almost time.
Time to take your proper spot.
An occasional walk ... does help with remembering things we barely think about when busy.
I'll find a way to make it up to everyone.
Memory might have faded for you, but never for the city that waited.
So, you did plan this from the start, and gave yourself an excuse to leave the lab.
My original plan involved a proper tour of Wuling with a rather detailed itinerary.
...I suddenly wanted you to walk these streets of Wuling not as a strategist, but as a wanderer.
Yeah. Very sudden indeed.
So for this unexpected reception, how would you rate Wuling's ... performance?
Endmin...

options: The chase helped me vent off some steam.
I actually had plenty of fun!
So, people kept talking about a performance.

scenes.summary: Your actions gave Zhuang Fangyi a satisfactory answer. She tells you about the past of Wuling and herself.

lines.text: Tired?
I'm afraid I didn't really catch it back then because of the noise. Sorry.
But I already have the answer I need.
The moment the Academy told me about your return, I began rehearsing a decade's worth of stories.
But there's too much to be done, and the stories worth sharing are few.
Anything you feel like hearing, Endmin?
I was completely overwhelmed.
Until one day, I read a question on the title page of an old book. It was a self-reflection written by a Tumu Tianshi.
I asked myself the same question, and only submitted my applications after some deliberation...
"Will the young still see the verdant hills and rivers?"
One day, time will write that reply for us.
But at this moment, the looming threat is what matters most.
That's ... something I need to think about...
Mmm.
Before I joined the Wuling Science Expedition, I had many options ... and problems as well.
It's just a very simple question.
But in this untamed land, that question claws at my chest. Unexpectedly, unrelentingly.
Endmin, I'm truly happy to see you back.

options: I do have something to say about Wuling...
We still have time to talk.
This seems like a great time for stories.
This turned out to be a rather eventful trip...
But sorry... I can't remember much about Wuling.
I seem to have missed out on many things...

lines.text: Ready to head over?
This way, please.
Of course. I'll be waiting here.

options: Hold on. I want a closer look at this lab.

r: Hold on. I want a closer look at this lab.

lines.text: Chassis undamaged. Please keep your paws off the hood.
Path obstructed. Please clear the roads ASAP.
Assistance required!

options: Maybe we should give it a love tap.
We should open the hood for an inspection.
I don't think we can do anything about this.

scenes.summary: With bated breaths, everyone waits for the results of the test run. Both you and Zhuang give sighs of relief when it finally works. While waiting for the blueprints of Xiranite production facilities, Zhuang takes you on a tour of the Xiranite Central Laboratory.

lines.text: So? Is it working?
Er ... we've got this?
It ... worked! Wait! Let me check the data!
Me too!
Endmin...
Yes, though it's just a first step.
We're looking for a set of suitable parameters. They'll ensure the Xiranite production facilities are PAC-compatible.
With the success of our first step, we can start designing the blueprints of said facilities.
Impressive ... and faster than expected. This could have only been achieved thanks to the Tianshi.
Indeed. We should really give them some time to rest...
Our research center has just received data from the Tianshi.
However, it'll take a while to get the completed blueprints from them...
While we wait, perhaps I can take the Endmin on a tour of the Central Laboratory.
I can handle things on my own. Chen, why don't you join the tour as well?
Me? Tianshi Zhuang has our Endmin covered. I can't add much. Maybe I should...
Since Chen just returned to Wuling. Maybe there are places that she wants to visit again.
Heheh... Yeah, this city's changed a lot. I really wanna do some exploring...
Okay ... then I'm leaving our Endmin in your hands, Tianshi Zhuang.
Mmm.
One more run. Same parameters.
Me? Thank you, but I'm alright.
Ge Yipu and Chang Yun spent months on this project without a break. Compared to them, my contributions pale.
I appreciate your concern.
I never thought I'd hear you say this to me. The Endmin from my memories never showed restraint.
...Supervisor Perlica.

options: Let me guess. Results are good?
Maybe there are other things to verify...
You seem in need of a break.

scenes.summary: While en route to the data room, you and Zhuang Fangyi run into Wu Jingwei. Zhuang refuses Wu's friendly offer of looking for the data. Instead, she accompanies you herself to find reports documenting the events after the completion of the Science Station.

lines.text: All reports and data generated since the founding of the Science Station are stored in this place.
Zhuang! Just at the right time! I was about to give you these data reports...
Oh? The Endmin's here too?
I'm with the Endmin. We're looking for information from the past.
Oh, you should have told me, girl. I can easily retrieve them for you!
It's alright. I know where the records are.
As for these reports, please deliver them to Supervisor Perlica. Thank you.
Haha. Alright, girl. I'll do as you say.
Let's go, Endmin. They should be over here.
Ah, well, there are moments when memories fail. Let's look for it together.

scenes.summary: After reading the files in the data room, Zhuang Fangyi curiously asks you about your views about Wuling City. However, your answer fails to satisfy her. After a short discussion, she decides to take the tour outside the lab.

lines.text: Don't you want to spend more time here? There are still some documents in the data room.
That being said, I was busy showing you around the place. I didn't even ask you how you felt about the city.
That was pretty rude of me.
So, Endmin. What do you think about this place?
Haha. Do you think you'll like this place?
Never doubted it.
I brought you here because I wanted to share a few moments from the past.
Supervisor Perlica might need a while to get things done. Let's just wait outside.

options: Many things have happened since then...
I'm afraid the answers aren't really here.
Well, me from the past probably did.
We'll do what we can to protect Wuling City.

r: Many things have happened since then...
I'm afraid the answers aren't really here.
Well, me from the past probably did.
We'll do what we can to protect Wuling City.

scenes.summary: Perlica informs you that blueprints for the Xiranite-producing facility are completed. You part ways with Zhuang Fangyi for now and prepare to make your way to Perlica at the Core AIC Area.

lines.text: Tianshi Zhuang, Endmin, the blueprints for the Xiranite production facilities are ready. We can now progress to the next phase of our collaboration.
Good. I've notified Chen to make her way to the Core AIC Area. Let's rendezvous there!
Thank you, but no... I've already taken my break, so it's time to get myself back to the Institute of Materials Science. Then I'll head to the Main Pillar and monitor the Tianshi Pillar Array.
Me too.
I'm all ready.
Nevertheless ... do allow me to express my gratitude.
An eternity passed... Yet now, hope stirs again.
But Chang Yun has been sending me data for quite a while. The situation is getting a little hot.
Next time we meet, I'll get to see the technological wonders of Endfield, right?

options: At least we're both seeking the same answers.
Join us at the Core AIC Area?
I hope I can stay for a while.

r: At least we're both seeking the same answers.
Join us at the Core AIC Area?
I hope I can stay for a while.
